mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The reducible configuration is an omission set, so restoring elements removes parts of that configuration. Partitioning omissions, retaining reductions that reproduce failure, and checking each final single restoration preserve delta debugging's mechanism. Explicit stopping rules permit unresolved or provisional outcomes without claiming completed minimization.

warrant_validity.rationale: The specified reference comparison, fixed remainder, participant allocation and exposure controls support the bounded interpretation of omission/restoration outcomes. Reproducible failure establishes test-relative sufficiency of the omissions; successful single restorations establish 1-minimality. A singleton supports necessity only with the reference remainder fixed. The specified neither/either/both comparisons support the cautious interaction interpretation. The mapping does not promote these results to universal necessity, global minimality or a unique causal mechanism.

target_fidelity.rationale: The inference contributes directly to identifying conditionally necessary onboarding elements and combinations whose effects depend on context. It explicitly distinguishes singleton necessity from jointly failing omissions and explains why alternative support and interactions can defeat an independent feature ranking. Its scope remains the tested prototype, users and tasks.

conditions.condition: Valid prototype variants and resources for repeated participant testing must be available.
conditions.rationale: The mapping assumes variants can be built and repeatedly tested. Obtaining implementations, participants and outcome-recording capacity enables the specified procedure. The evidential controls and interpretation are already specified by the mapping; resource availability does not establish them.

preconditions.condition: Valid prototype variants and resources for repeated participant testing must be available.
preconditions.how_to_establish: Implement the reference and dependency-valid omission/restoration variants, arrange participant testing, and provide the specified completion and funnel-event recording.
preconditions.why_execution_only: These resources enable the proposed tests without changing their reduction mechanism, evidential comparisons, bounded inference or target.

execution_readiness.rationale: The packet assumes execution capacity but does not establish its availability. Establishing reproducible reference success and omission-induced failure is part of the proposed procedure, with an explicit stop rule if either fails; a favorable result is not required for prospective validity.

uncertainty: No observations establish whether a reproducibly failing omission set exists, whether minimization will complete, or which elements and interactions will be implicated.
Dependencies and unresolved outcomes may restrict the obtainable result to a provisional reduced set, as the mapping explicitly allows.
